title: FFT: Towards Evaluating Large Language Models with Factuality, Fairness, Toxicity
findings: LLMs exhibit greater performance disparity (i.e., less fairness) across religious and gender identities compared to racial identities. GPT models (GPT-4 and GPT-3.5) demonstrated greater fairness and less bias across religious groups compared to the open-source models tested.
references: Isabelle Augenstein, Timothy Baldwin, Meeyoung Cha, Tanmoy Chakraborty, Giovanni Luca Ciampaglia, David Corney, Renee DiResta, Emilio Ferrara, Scott Hale, Alon Halevy, et al. 2023. Factuality challenges in the era of large language models. arXiv preprint arXiv:2310.05189 (2023).
